title: Matsumoto Castle
axis: +X east toward dry Honmaru court and moon-viewing projection; +Z south along main keep ridge; +Y up.
geometryLabel: Native five-structure stone-cap outline; interpreted internal partitions. Detached gates, external red bridge and city excluded.
source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap; inspected local2013–2019 originals and operator structure/2018 visitor guide.
identityStatus: One native L-shaped connected keep-complex root. Native17m applies to entire root and cannot define the29.4m main keep or the five distinct measured silhouettes.

orientationControl.basis: East court original2013 places Moon south/left, Inui north/right and main north/south top ridge. Main east/west triangular and north/south curved high gables reconcile with operator description. Inui upper ridge runs east/west. Native near north/south west wall fixes signed axes.

terrainContact.basis: Dry Honmaru courtyard east of main keep and north of Tatsumi/Moon wings; unchanged original GSI1A provider590.06m reference[18,-6], outside the stone base/roof/inner moat.

limitations: Unified native outline is a cartographic control, not a measured stone toe, roof eave or individual building-part plan. Component partitions and unseen junctions need photographic/owner-guide interpretation.

Native17m must not be extruded across entire root. Operator visitor-guide approximate main29.4/Inui16.8/Watari12.0/Tatsumi14.7/Tsukimi11.1m labels control relative silhouettes, but vertical endpoints require review.

The first accepted original has snow that obscures tile colours. Current daylight supplements control gray tile/black board/white plaster palette; snow, trees, external red bridge, detached gates, office, town and interiors excluded.
Independent original terrain must be preserved before geometry; no fitting or flattening, and moat source height must not be represented as a surveyed bed or water level.

Operator29.4/16.8/12/14.7/11.1m labels are interpreted as approximate silhouette controls relative to the dry court; precise datum endpoints/individual floor levels are unspecified. Gray shachi heights and ornament are authored estimates, not Nagoya gold measurements.

nativeAxes.x: east toward Honmaru court and Moon wing

notes: Native whole polygon is partitioned without changing its external coordinates; internal divisions between main/Inui/Watari/Tatsumi/Moon components are interpreted from actual photographs and operator guide, not surveyed building-part polygons. Native17m root height is not used to extrude all five structures. Roof eaves, battered lower stone toe and red Moon veranda extend beyond cartographic cap controls as bounded exterior interpretation.
